parameters.query:
INSERT INTO articles (content_hash, url, title, summary, published_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::timestamptz)
ON CONFLICT (content_hash) DO UPDATE SET processed_at = now()
  WHERE articles.is_ma IS NULL
RETURNING id, content_hash, title, url, summary, published_at;
UPDATE articles SET is_ma = false WHERE id = $1::int;

parameters.text:
=You extract structured M&A deal data from a news article for a database.
Use ONLY information stated in the article. Never guess or invent values.

Fields:
- acquirer: the buying company (for a merger, the first company named).
- target: the company, stake or business unit being acquired.
- target_description: what the target does, max 12 words (e.g. "cloud security software provider"). "" if unknown.
- deal_type: exactly one of acquisition, merger, majority_stake, minority_stake, asset_purchase, other.
- status: exactly one of announced, pending, completed, terminated, rumoured.
- value_millions: deal value in millions of the stated currency (e.g. $1.2 billion → 1200). 0 if not disclosed.
- currency: 3-letter ISO code (USD, EUR, GBP...). "" if no value is disclosed.
- geography: country of the target company. "" if unknown.
- announced_date: YYYY-MM-DD only if the article states the date, otherwise "".
- rationale: why the deal is happening, max 25 words. "" if not stated.
- confidence: number from 0 to 1, how sure you are that the fields above are correct.

Article:
Title: {{ $('New article?').item.json.title }}
Published: {{ $('New article?').item.json.published_at }}
Text: {{ $('New article?').item.json.summary }}

parameters.query:
WITH d AS (
  INSERT INTO deals (deal_key, acquirer, target, target_description, deal_type, status,
                     value_m, currency, geography, announced_date, rationale, confidence, source_url)
  VALUES ($1, $2, $3, NULLIF($4,''), $5, $6,
          NULLIF($7,'')::numeric, NULLIF($8,''), NULLIF($9,''), NULLIF($10,'')::date,
          NULLIF($11,''), $12::numeric, $13)
  ON CONFLICT (deal_key) DO UPDATE SET
    target_description = COALESCE(deals.target_description, EXCLUDED.target_description),
    deal_type      = CASE WHEN deals.deal_type = 'other' THEN EXCLUDED.deal_type ELSE deals.deal_type END,
    status         = CASE WHEN deals.status IN ('completed','terminated') THEN deals.status ELSE EXCLUDED.status END,
    value_m        = COALESCE(deals.value_m, EXCLUDED.value_m),
    currency       = CASE WHEN deals.value_m IS NULL THEN EXCLUDED.currency ELSE deals.currency END,
    geography      = COALESCE(deals.geography, EXCLUDED.geography),
    announced_date = LEAST(deals.announced_date, EXCLUDED.announced_date),
    rationale      = COALESCE(deals.rationale, EXCLUDED.rationale),
    confidence     = GREATEST(deals.confidence, EXCLUDED.confidence),
    source_count   = deals.source_count + 1,
    last_seen      = now()
  RETURNING id, acquirer, target, value_m, currency, source_count, (xmax = 0) AS is_new
)
UPDATE articles a
SET is_ma = true, deal_id = d.id
FROM d
WHERE a.id = $14::int
RETURNING d.id AS deal_id, d.acquirer, d.target, d.value_m, d.currency, d.source_count, d.is_new;

SELECT content_hash
FROM articles
WHERE content_hash = ANY(string_to_array($1, ','))
  AND is_ma IS NOT NULL;

UPDATE articles SET is_ma = true
WHERE id = $1::int AND $2::boolean = false;
